objective.text: Defeat the Hookhand and Harpooner. Watch where the Hookhand pulls your heroes.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls to the hook pair.
objective.victory_event: The last member of the pair falls.

objective.text: Defeat every opponent. An adjacent Shieldbearer reduces damage to the Archer by 1 per Shieldbearer. Separate them or defeat the guards.
objective.victory_text: The company breaks the veteran shield wall.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls to the veteran shield wall.

objective.text: Defeat every opponent. When a Bomber dies, it deals 2 damage to every adjacent living character, friend or foe. Bombers can set each other off.
objective.victory_text: The company survives the veteran explosive situation.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls in the veteran explosive situation.

objective.text: Defeat every opponent. The rival Knight pushes and follows taunts, the rival Wizard blasts the nearest character, and the rival Healer restores wounded allies within 2 tiles twice.
objective.victory_text: The company defeats its veteran rivals.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls to its veteran rivals.

objective.text: Defeat every opponent. The Healer can restore 2 HP to a wounded ally within 2 tiles twice per battle. Stop the healing or defeat the Bruisers first.
objective.victory_text: The company defeats the veteran Healer's party.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls to the veteran Healer's party.

objective.text: Defeat every opponent. The Trickster can swap places with the Ogre once per battle. The Ogre is slow but hits hard.
objective.victory_text: The company defeats the veteran odd couple.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls to the veteran odd couple.

objective.text: Defeat every opponent. The Hookhand can pull a hero toward the Bomber. When the Bomber falls, its blast deals 2 damage to every adjacent living character, friend or foe. Watch the Harpooner too.
objective.victory_text: The company clears the fuse line.
objective.defeat_text: The company falls at the fuse line.
